baseline.assessmentRule: Contract/schema tests are contract evidence; API tests count only when they exercise the real HTTP and persistence boundary; UI connection requires a browser flow making real application API calls; integration evidence must cover the whole acceptance scenario; synthetic development/staging evidence is not pilot verification.
baseline.pilotEvidenceLimit: Existing dated verification artifacts explicitly say synthetic development/staging and actualPilotDeployed=false. The example configuration pack is not a selected project pack. No actual project role assignments, field work IDs, snapshots, or owner acceptance evidence were found.

scenarios.provenScope: HTTP inspection case linkage and stable reinspection context; browser inspection-case graph and explicit command entry; reference-engine end-to-end closeout trace; contractor issue closure control absent.
gaps: No single real HTTP plus connected-browser flow proves FAIL→Issue→Action→Reinspection→current-cycle closure evidence→SUP close and Owner follow-up remaining independently open.
Reference-engine end-to-end proof is not real HTTP/persistence integration evidence; browser tests do not establish the entire chain.
scenarios.nextWork: Add integrated API/browser acceptance flow with rejection, correction, reinspection, current-cycle evidence, SUP closure, and separately unresolved/closed Owner Report assertions.

scenarios.provenScope: Real HTTP safety persistence, restart, current equipment/evidence gates, stale-version/idempotency/atomic stop behavior. Browser test issues acknowledge-stop through real API and proves premature resume is guarded. Synthetic staging operational validation records explicit stop-lift/resume separation, supervisor resume and contractor self-resume denial.
gaps: Browser/API acceptance flow does not complete remedy→reverification→explicit stop lift→authorized resume as one scenario.
Existing staging record is synthetic development/staging, not site acceptance; it does not promote the scenario to pilot_verified.
Issue #112 correctly requests F-03 ledger promotion only to backend_api_implemented; it explicitly excludes ui_connected because existing workspace UI test mocks some routes.
scenarios.nextWork: Resolve #112 evidence/ledger alignment separately; add real API-backed browser flow through explicit lift and resume, including denied paths, restart, stale version and idempotent replay.

scenarios.provenScope: Recorded real source upload/import, approvals, progress, delay/recovery, Notice/EOT, Owner decisions, exact approved revision, idempotency/version rejection and effective baseline revision. Validation artifact records all browser/API/contract/PostgreSQL checks passing.
gaps: Validation is explicitly synthetic development/staging; no actual pilot project/actor acceptance.
scenarios.nextWork: Use as the current implementation-stage example; retain pilot_verified as unavailable until field scenario and evidence are supplied.

scenarios.provenScope: Machine-backed contract and reference validation preserve claimed/verified/recommended/owner-approved/paid amount boundaries, exact BOQ history, duplicate-claim guards and cumulative reconciliation.
gaps: No payment claim/measurement HTTP route acceptance, database persistence/restart proof, connected payment UI or full Owner approval→Payment Record flow found.
Contract unit tests do not prove actual payment execution or payment.
scenarios.nextWork: Implement/verify real HTTP persistence and connected UI for measurement verification, SUP recommendation, Owner adjustment/approval and separate payment record; cover rejected/returned/resubmitted and replay/version cases.

scenarios.provenScope: Functional contract and form/schema mappings specify packages, readiness, handover and warranty fields. This is design/form evidence only.
gaps: No CommissioningPackage/HandoverPackage/WarrantyClaim state machines or domain persistence implementation found.
No commissioning, handover, or warranty HTTP API resources/routes, connected UI, or execution acceptance tests found.
No proof of O&M/documentation readiness gate, partial scope isolation, conditional reservations, immutable original fail/retest, Owner acceptance, or warranty reinspection before close.
scenarios.nextWork: Build domain state/authority/persistence contract mapping, API and real UI for commissioning→readiness→Owner acceptance→warranty defect/remedy/reinspection/close; add full rejection/rework/retest and forbidden-transition tests.

scenarios.provenScope: HTTP coverage includes human review gates, no-findings not becoming official pass, video coverage/PTS, original transcript and worker retry/audit behavior; separate HTTP tests cover eligible observation-to-issue provenance.
gaps: No connected browser E2E was found spanning resumable upload, completed analysis coverage, candidate confirmation/rejection, and eligible-only official Issue creation.
External provider availability, multilingual accuracy and field false-positive performance remain separate operational/data-set validation; mocks or test providers cannot establish model performance.
scenarios.nextWork: Add real API-backed UI candidate-review E2E plus worker restart/failure and actual approved-provider representative dataset acceptance if media is enabled.

scenarios.provenScope: Some storage and object-reference boundaries reject cross-project access; configuration guards reject invalid authority bindings.
gaps: No acceptance flow was found that logs into two actual projects and proves both cross-project object reads and commands are denied across representative domain APIs.
scenarios.nextWork: Add authenticated two-project HTTP tests covering object GET, command execution, evidence/download and linked-reference paths; keep data non-disclosing on denial.

scenarios.provenScope: Safety execution contract tests cover qualification/readiness and current certificates in domain scenarios.
gaps: No identified real HTTP test expires a qualification after a signed decision and proves a new official decision is rejected while the old signature remains retrievable and unchanged.
scenarios.nextWork: Add HTTP/persistence regression for qualification expiry after historical approval, then browser conflict/denial presentation if the workflow is in pilot scope.

scenarios.provenScope: Authority matrix defines actor decision rights and selected ADM administration APIs have HTTP tests.
gaps: No targeted acceptance test proves ADM cannot technically approve or close an Issue through the command API and connected UI while allowed administrative actions still work.
scenarios.nextWork: Add negative real HTTP commands for technical approval and Issue close as ADM, assert no state/audit decision mutation, and browser displays server denial.

scenarios.provenScope: Stale version writes are rejected by selected real APIs; schedule browser proves real API rejection and refresh of saved version.
gaps: A consistent UI conflict and recovery path is not evidenced across the priority pilot workflows (quality, safety, payment, handover).
scenarios.nextWork: Reuse a real two-session stale write acceptance helper for each pilot workflow and assert explicit conflict, refresh, and user-directed retry.

scenarios.provenScope: Selected create/command/upload/worker retry boundaries use idempotency and test stable outcome or single logical candidate.
gaps: No single acceptance surface demonstrates that browser submit timeout/retry preserves one official record across each required pilot workflow.
scenarios.nextWork: Add timeout/replay tests for high-impact commands and verify record count plus stable returned ID/version; include UI retry behavior.

scenarios.provenScope: Object storage upload/verification failures and selected API persistence boundaries have focused tests.
gaps: No end-to-end acceptance was found proving a domain command that requires evidence cannot report success when durable blob storage fails, followed by safe retry/recovery.
scenarios.nextWork: Inject object-store failure during an evidence-required official command and assert no finalized domain result, no orphaned false success, and recoverable retry.

scenarios.provenScope: Outbox replay, bounded retry, lease fencing, invalid output rollback and explicit unconfigured-provider failure are tested.
gaps: No real deployed process-kill/restart acceptance proves one logical result after recovery; no pilot worker/provider evidence. Heartbeat alone remains insufficient.
scenarios.nextWork: Add disposable API/worker integration that kills worker after claim/provider response, restarts, and asserts one committed result or explicit failure with audit trail.

scenarios.provenScope: Report workflow unit tests require linked Action/Decision before close; real HTTP API creates provenance-linked closeout drafts; UI separates the case view from dispatch/receipt flow.
gaps: No single connected browser/API acceptance proves domain Issue close leaves a linked Owner Report action/decision open and blocks report close until receipt, dispatch, verification and follow-up close rules pass.
scenarios.nextWork: Add connected API/browser test from domain close through report draft, Owner receipt, dispatch, follow-up verification, and independent report close guard.

scenarios.provenScope: Browser coverage asserts offline evidence remains local until explicit upload.
gaps: No offline command queue/reconnect conflict flow was found that rejects last-write-wins and surfaces the conflicting server/current versions for human resolution.
scenarios.nextWork: Implement explicit conflict UI for reconnecting offline changes and test competing online/offline edits with a human-selected resolution.

crossCuttingGaps.finding: The acceptance scope requires required reports in Korean, Vietnamese and English. The web client defaults document rendering to Korean; inspected product UI uses Korean literals and ko-KR formatting. No EN/VI/KR locale catalogs, locale selection/fallback, translated report templates, or multilingual snapshot tests were found. Existing document policy says Vietnamese is the legal completion-document baseline and permits additional languages by agreement; that policy is not implementation evidence.
crossCuttingGaps.gap: Implement locale-aware required-report UI/rendering in ko/vi/en and exact-source language tests; preserve the Vietnamese legal original and agreed bilingual versions with source/version provenance.

mustBeSuppliedForSelectedProject: Chosen project and validated Project Configuration Pack, including pack/config version and selected required acceptance scenarios.
Real SUP, CON and OWN accounts with active project RoleAssignments; DES and ADM accounts/assignments for role-boundary acceptance.
Core qualification/certificate records, holders, scopes and validity/expiry dates for the actual pilot period.
Approved project, package, location and discipline scope assignments for each role.
Owner P1–P4 report routing, recipient references, acknowledgment/follow-up owners and due-time rules.
Adopted DOUL forms and legal original-form identifiers, plus agreed report languages / controlling language.
Named backup/restore accountable owner, restore contact, outage escalation line and an agreed recovery exercise window.
For enabled media: approved provider/runtime, data export/transfer decision, retention/deletion period, cost owner/limit, and representative approved field media set.
evidenceToCapture: Project/config version, build/commit, actor-role setup references with no secrets, and generated business object IDs/versions.
Executed commands and outcomes, rejection reasons, linked evidence IDs, screen/log/document snapshot references, defects/workarounds and owner acceptance decision.
pilotPrerequisites.securityRule: Use account and secret references only in this inventory; never include passwords, tokens, private keys, or real personal identifiers.
